roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: What we build next, ordered by what a lifestyle client needs to keep going.
roadmap.clear_filters_to_see_more: Clear the filters to see the rest of the roadmap.
roadmap.rule_1: The client is a lifestyle client. If an item does not help a normal person show up next week, it is parked with a reason or it stays off the board.
roadmap.rule_2: Every item names the loop step it fixes and the evidence it stands on. Evidence is one of production, demand elsewhere, the adherence PRD, a device check, or a product call.
roadmap.rule_3: Now stays small. Capacity is fixed, so parking is the discipline — MacroFactor's board carries 48 open asks and 113,863 votes, four years unresolved. That is the failure mode.
roadmap.rule_4: Advanced and heavy-user scope is parked and hidden behind the lens, so it can never quietly become the plan.
roadmap.rule_5: The board is the source of truth for order. Edit apps/dashboard/src/features/roadmap/items.ts — the first item in a column is the next one to pick up.
roadmap.horizon_now_blurb: In flight this cycle. Small on purpose.
roadmap.horizon_next_blurb: The cycle after the launch gate passes.
roadmap.horizon_later_blurb: After the loop works. Dated only where the market has a date.
roadmap.horizon_parked_blurb: Decided not now. The reason stays on the card.
roadmap.theme_start_blurb: Signup, onboarding and the first plan.
roadmap.theme_coach_blurb: The human layer and the dashboard.
roadmap.theme_data_blurb: Catalogue trust, Apple Health, Arabic, release.
roadmap.segment_lifestyle_blurb: The self-serve client. The default lens.
roadmap.segment_coached_blurb: Client working with a human coach.
roadmap.segment_advanced_blurb: Heavy-user territory. Hidden behind the lens.
roadmap.evidence_production_blurb: Seen in production or in the code as it ships.
roadmap.evidence_demand_blurb: Votes and threads from the MacroFactor board.
roadmap.evidence_policy_blurb: An Azbfit decision. Not a claim of evidence.

rescue.title: A 10-minute rescue session for the days that fall apart
rescue.why: A missed training day has no recovery path in the code at all. The smallest possible action beats a lost week — adherence over optimisation.

comeback.title: Ramp back after a break instead of starting over
comeback.why: The loop after activation does not exist: one production client activated and nothing carries them past a lapse. A ramp-back keeps showing up worth something.

nudge-engine.title: One cue a day that opens straight into the action
nudge-engine.why: Push is wired for chat only and wrangler.jsonc has no cron trigger, so the plan waits on memory. Routines need a cue, and the cue needs to land on the action.

checkin-ritual.title: Make the weekly check-in the ritual it was designed to be
checkin-ritual.why: check_in_submitted has never fired in any environment. One ask a week, structured reasons, and no moralising — restraint eaters get support, not guilt.

weekly-recap.title: Give the week back as something worth reading
weekly-recap.why: The launch gate asks for a meaningful answer at the end of the week. The recap is the check-in payoff, the share-card source and the retention moment.

first-week.title: Carry a new client through week one without a coach
first-week.why: Exactly one production profile has activated. The first seven days decide whether the app becomes a habit or an install that never opens again.

health-steps-verify.title: Apple Health steps, verified on a real phone
health-steps-verify.why: The permission-and-readback path is unverified on device. Home should only ever show what it actually read.

catalog-saudi.title: Saudi food coverage: verified restaurant items, clean barcodes
catalog-saudi.why: Data trust is the top complaint on every comparable board (MacroFactor: flag bad entries, 3,974 votes). Coverage of what people actually eat here decides whether logging survives week one.

analytics-loop.title: Measure the loop end to end
analytics-loop.why: PR #31 adds session starts, nudges and plan cohorts. Without it, every decision below is a guess.

meal-repeat.title: Repeat a meal in one tap
meal-repeat.why: The most-requested logging feature on MacroFactor's board — 5,777 votes, filed in 2022, still open. Most people eat the same breakfast every day.

meal-suggest.title: Suggest meals from what the client already eats
meal-suggest.why: MacroFactor: 5,136 votes on meal suggestions. Habits are the cheapest plan — no new food to learn, no decision to make after work.

weighin-nudge.title: A weigh-in reminder that fits the routine
weighin-nudge.why: MacroFactor's biggest reminder ask, 6,649 votes. It rides the nudge engine, so it adds a habit without adding a surface.

water.title: Water logging for a hot-climate routine
water.why: MacroFactor: 5,635 votes. Hydration is the most lifestyle-specific habit in a Saudi summer, and the cheapest possible win after logging food.

arabic-quality.title: Arabic that reads native wherever it shows
arabic-quality.why: Both languages ship, but the last Arabic attempt was reverted for quality and the dashboard is English-only. Client-facing copy in two languages is a requirement, not a translation pass.

share-card.title: A weekly summary the client can send to a friend
share-card.why: MacroFactor: sharing the log, 3,329 votes. In this market the share is the growth loop — behaviour only, never body data.

measurements.title: Body measurements so slow progress is visible
measurements.why: Weight alone under-reports change. The recap needs a second axis a client can trust on a plateau week.

streaks.title: Two-track, repairable streaks and badges
streaks.why: A naive day-streak punishes rest days and illness. Identity is the retention payoff, and it depends on the rescue events landing first.

coach-visibility.title: Check-in reasons and trends on the coach dashboard
coach-visibility.why: The data that drives the client's next step is what a coach wants before a call. The dashboard stays oversight, never a prerequisite.

training-videos.title: Exercise videos that play on a bad gym connection
training-videos.why: The exerciseDemo fallback is unverified on device. Caching keeps the session moving when the signal drops in a basement gym.

step-target-policy.title: Settle the step-target ceiling and movement credit
step-target-policy.why: Open onboarding decision: what happens above the schema ceiling, and whether surplus movement credits food or caps pace. Pick one and write it down.

ramadan.title: Ramadan mode: fasting-aware days, iftar-aligned meals
ramadan.why: The year's biggest lifestyle event, next around Feb 2027. MacroFactor's fasting asks (3,896 votes) point the same way; ours has a date.

meal-plan-week.title: Plan the week's meals, not just the day
meal-plan-week.why: MacroFactor: 6,659 votes and their oldest unresolved ask. For a lifestyle client it means fewer decisions after work, which is where plans usually die.

sleep-context.title: Read sleep from Apple Health as context, not a tracker
sleep-context.why: MacroFactor's single largest ask, 14,155 votes, still open after four years. We use it to explain a rough week, not to add a tracking burden.

widgets.title: Home-screen widget: today at a glance
widgets.why: MacroFactor: 2,485 votes. A glanceable plan is a cue that costs no attention — the cheapest retention surface there is.

referral.title: Bring a friend: referral with badges, not discounts
referral.why: Depends on the share card and the streaks. This market grows through personal networks, and there is no payment layer to discount yet.

fasting-window.title: Fasting window indicator for voluntary fasting
fasting-window.why: MacroFactor: 3,896 votes. In this market voluntary fasting is a normal week, not a niche, and it pairs with the Ramadan work.

cycle-overlay.title: Cycle-aware weight trend
cycle-overlay.why: MacroFactor: period overlay, 3,635 votes. It explains a broken-scale week before it erodes trust in the whole product.

web-client.title: Client web app
web-client.why: MacroFactor: 5,281 votes, mostly desktop users who live in a browser.
web-client.parked: Our clients are phone-first. Revisit if desktop signup shows real demand.

alcohol-calc.title: Alcohol calorie calculator
alcohol-calc.why: MacroFactor: 4,773 votes — a fair ask for their market.
alcohol-calc.parked: Not our market. Choosing our users means saying no.

micronutrients.title: Micronutrient targets (iodine, %DV, pregnancy)
micronutrients.parked: Advanced scope. Energy, protein, fat, carbs and fibre cover the lifestyle job.

net-carbs.title: Net carbs
net-carbs.parked: Serves one diet tribe and confuses everyone else at the label.

wearables.title: Garmin, Oura and Whoop integrations
wearables.why: MacroFactor: 763 votes — and MacroFactor itself marked it won't-do.
wearables.parked: Apple Health covers the realistic device mix here; integrations multiply support cost.

poop-tracker.title: Digestive tracker
poop-tracker.parked: Weak loop fit. Revisit only if gut complaints recur in check-in reasons.

watch-app.title: Apple Watch companion
watch-app.why: The freshest demand on MacroFactor's board — filed January 2026, 1,964 votes.
watch-app.parked: A watch app serves heavy users. Phone-first until the adherence data says otherwise.

family-plan.title: Family and household plan
family-plan.why: MacroFactor: 339 votes. Gulf households cook and move together, so the behaviour is real.
family-plan.parked: A commercial decision, and there is no payment layer yet. After the loop proves itself.
